title: CARE-Edit linked its public project site and code repository
summary: On 2026-03-11, the CARE-Edit development line linked the project website and its GitHub code repository. This is a material public-availability step because it gave readers access to a project resource and implementation resource. The post itself has not been researched, so this entry does not assert a model release, technical capability, or repository version beyond the dated links.
